description:
One loot table with every drop. The loot source's `id` and `name` plus `drops`, highest chance first: for each item `shortname`,
`display_name`, `icon_url`, `chance_pct` (0-100), `amount_min`/`amount_max` and, for items that spawn
damaged, `condition_min_pct`/`condition_max_pct`. Scraped from wiki.facepunch.com; cached for 30 minutes.

source_id.description: Loot source id from `/loot-tables`, `/monuments/{slug}` or an item's `loot_sources`.

name: get_loot_table
title: One loot table with every drop
